keyword: what is the cut for the masters
claims: The cut at the Masters reduces the field to the top 50 players plus ties after 36 holes.
The 2026 Masters cut was set at 4-over 148.
Only the top 50 and ties make the Masters cut.
Previously, players within 10 strokes of the lead also made the Masters cut.
The Masters cut is the most challenging cut among all four men's major golf championships.
The Masters cut is finalized after the completion of the second round on Friday.
Players who finish in the top 50 or ties after Friday continue playing Saturday and Sunday.
Players who make the Masters cut receive a share of the prize money.
The final two rounds at the Masters are rounds 3 and 4.
The record low Masters cut was even-par in 2020.
The record high Masters cut was 10-over in 1982.
